description: Allegheny County-Owned Bridges Points is a dataset listed in Western Pennsylvania Regional Data Center (WPRDC), an open data portal, published or maintained by Allegheny County. This dataset was previously obtained and regularly updated from this URL on Allegheny County's GIS server. It is no longer a listed dataset, so we have stopped updating it. This dataset shows the location of bridges owned by Allegheny County as centroids. Coverage: Allegheny County, Pennsylvania. The portal files it under the publisher Allegheny County. Its tags are _gisds, _orphaned_etl, infrastructure, planning, property. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML, ZIP. The portal shows 2025-12-01 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-wprdc-portal.
